blocks.text: Xia Vigor is set to headline the Philippine movie adaptation of the hit South Korean musical drama “Dream High,” which will be produced by Viva One. The announcement was made as part of Viva One’s presentation of its upcoming programs during the launch of its “Viva One: The New TV” campaign on Tuesday, Nov. 24. Vigor will be joined by fellow young actors Althea Ablan, Charles Law, Noel Comia Jr., Gab Evangelista, and Ali Suzuki in the upcoming series. Director Petersen Vargas will helm the local adaptation, which is expected to premiere on the streaming platform in 2027. READ: David Licauco, […]...
